summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated hardcoded network destination in messages-send
details: diezyyasha-baileys is an unofficial fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js (line 425 and line 436) constructs a hardcoded URL via String.fromCharCode(...) that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/, an author-controlled endpoint unrelated to WhatsApp's own infrastructure. The destination is obfuscated as a decimal char-code array to hide the literal host from casual inspection, and is embedded in the outbound-message send path, so normal use of the library's messaging API silently routes data through this endpoint. Obfuscated reconstruction of a non-first-party destination inside a message send flow of a session-bearing WhatsApp client is the characteristic shape of covert data relay / session-info exfiltration.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
